profile.title: AI Engineer & Data Scientist
profile.summary: AI Engineer with 3+ years of experience specializing in Computer Vision and LLM-based systems. work_experience.description: Led AI model development for industrial safety across 70+ zones. Focused on model architecture, training strategies, and data-centric AI.
highlights: • **Year 1 (Data & Training):** Focused heavily on data labeling workflows and training YOLOv4 models from scratch.

• **Year 2 (Leadership & R&D):** Led a **3-person Data Science team**. Conducted research on new architectures (Yolo models) and Depth estimation models (Midas, FOD) and anomaly detection models (PatchCore) and managed project timelines.
• **Year 3 (Optimization & Data-Centric AI):** Focused on dataset effectiveness and model optimization. Implemented **Optuna** for hyperparameter tuning.
• Achieved a **22.6% reduction in false positives** on a 670K+ image dataset using Optuna and Data-Centric strategies.
• Developed specialized modules for **Anomaly Detection (PatchCore)** and **Depth Estimation (Midas)**.
• Executed all model training and development operations on **Linux (Ubuntu)** servers.
• **Hardware Integration:** Managed data pipelines from industrial IP cameras, Stereo, and Lidar sensors for real-time inference.
• **Deployment & Automation:** Developed Python scripts for automated model execution, inference optimization (CUDA), and system integration on Linux edge devices.
• **Team Leadership:** Managed the full workflow from data labeling to model evaluation, delegating tasks within the Data Science team.

projects.name: Estate-Agent RAG Chatbot
projects.description: An intelligent, conversational real estate agent powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology. The system combines semantic search with structured filtering to provide accurate and natural property recommendations, focusing on the Bursa real estate market, understanding complex user queries about property search, location, budget, and more. It also integrates hybrid retrieval with vector search and metadata filtering for high-quality responses.
projects.info: This project implements a hybrid AI agent capable of handling both simple conversational tasks and complex real estate search queries. It uses a combination of semantic embeddings and structured filtering to search property data in ChromaDB, routes user queries intelligently between simple chat and full agent workflows, and supports auxiliary tools like weather, Wikipedia and web search integrations to enrich responses. Designed with Gradio as its front end, Estate-Agent leverages modern Python libraries and LLM inference to provide real-time property recommendations tailored to user criteria.

projects.name: AI Digital Twin - Cloud Deployment
projects.description: A hands-on MLOps project focused on building and deploying a production-ready machine learning service. The project demonstrates how to package an ML model as an API, containerize it, and expose it through a scalable deployment setup, emphasizing reproducibility, deployment best practices, and real-world MLOps workflows.
projects.info: This project showcases a practical MLOps workflow starting from a trained machine learning model to a deployable inference service. It includes API-based model serving, containerization for environment consistency, and a deployment-ready structure suitable for cloud environments. The focus is on operationalizing ML models rather than model training, highlighting key MLOps concepts such as reproducibility, service abstraction, and scalable deployment.

projects.name: Arxivangelist Multi-Task AI Agent
projects.description: A multitask AI agent developed as part of the HuggingFace Agents Course Unit 4, designed to answer diverse questions across domains such as math, web search, document processing, multimedia analysis and more, using a rich set of built-in tools and model integrations.
projects.info: Arxivangelist is an advanced multi-task AI agent system built as a final assignment for the HuggingFace Agents Course. It integrates numerous tools like web search, Wikipedia, file processing, transcription, math operations, and more to handle a wide range of tasks, achieving a benchmark accuracy of 30% on the GAIA evaluation. The agent utilizes a Gradio interface and can be run locally with an Ollama server and configured APIs for expanded capabilities.
